title: fix(objectql)!: an action body's write inside ctx.api.transaction keeps its audit rows beside a telemetry datasource
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_
Fixes #35028

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — inside a transaction opened by `ScopedContext`'s discrete begin/commit/rollback trio (the sandbox's `ctx.api.transaction`), a business write to an object on another datasource is now refused with `CrossDatasourceTransactionWriteError` (`ERR_CROSS_DATASOURCE_TRANSACTION_WRITE`, 400 at the action door). Before, it ran on the transaction's connection, the wrong one.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: follow-up #35117 (the `api.transaction` row: one datasource per body transaction; a write to an object on another datasource is refused)

> **BREAKING** for an action, hook or job body whose `ctx.api.transaction` writes an object bound to a non-default datasource. That write is now refused, naming both datasources, and the body's transaction rolls back. Fix: keep every object written inside one `ctx.api.transaction` on one datasource, or split the work per datasource. Single-datasource deployments see no change. ADR-0087 disposition (in the changeset): not-required (no-migration-prescription).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:沙箱 `ctx.api.transaction` 打开的事务句柄,现在在开启时记下归属的驱动;同源闸门据此判断,审计/动态行写到 telemetry 库自己的连接,跨库业务写被拒。
- 为什么改:有 telemetry 数据源时(每个 `os dev`、带 `OS_TELEMETRY_DB` 的 `os serve`),动作体事务里的写入丢失审计行和动态行,接口仍回 200。
- 风险与回滚:动作体事务里写另一个数据源上的业务对象,从"写错连接"变为 400 拒绝;单数据源不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/objectql/src/engine-scoped-context.ts`(beginTransaction 记录、commit/rollback 清除)、`packages/objectql/src/engine-execute-transactions.ts`(记录表与 enforceTransactionOrigin)、`packages/objectql/src/engine-middleware-and-context.ts`(transactionCoversDriverFor)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/engine-transaction-same-origin.test.ts`,预期 29 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:Tier H(改了 `docs/adr/**`),需 os-zhuang 在当前 head 上 APPROVED 审核。

## What changes

- `ScopedContext.beginTransaction` records the opened handle's owner (the same `TransactionScope` that `transaction(cb)` publishes), keyed by handle in a WeakMap. `commitTransaction` and `rollbackTransaction` drop it, also when the driver call throws.
- When `txStore` holds no scope for the handle, `transactionCoversDriverFor` and `enforceTransactionOrigin` read that record. So ledger rows (`sys_audit_log`, `sys_activity`) take the existing #5351 carve-out: written on `telemetry`, outside the body transaction, on their own connection. A cross-datasource business write is refused before any hook runs.
- `enforceTransactionOrigin` takes the write's explicit handle (`options.context.transaction`) as a fourth argument. That puts four one-line call-site edits outside the claim's file surface: `engine.ts` (the private wrapper), `engine-insert.ts`, `engine-update.ts` and `engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts`. Route A needs them, because the gate cannot otherwise see the handle.
- ADR-0119: an add-only dated note under "The declared LIMIT of the same-origin gate". It narrows the limit to handles the engine never opened. The existing paragraph is not rewritten.
- The optional plugin-audit fix-text change was not made. With this fix, the platform's own trio no longer produces that third cause.
- No `IDataDriver` or `packages/spec` change. The sudo() `'action'` elevation-mark defect (#35052) is not touched.
- Contract review S1 (fix round): `enforceTransactionOrigin` now discards an explicit handle the current run was detached from before it reads the trio record, with the same predicate the structural half uses (`isClosedUnitHandle`, `engine-driver-options.ts`). An `async: true` `afterFind` run starts outside every open unit while its `ctx.api` still carries the trio handle; before this, its cross-datasource business write was refused although `buildDriverOptions` ran it outside any transaction. It now lands on its own connection, as it does under `transaction(cb)`. The ADR-0119 note gains an add-only paragraph bounding "exactly the 2026-08-06 answers" (the detached run, and review nit N1: a primitive handle stays unattributed); the changeset gains one sentence. Nit N2 (a closed trio handle reverts to unattributed rather than closed) is unchanged here; the seat files its follow-up.

## Why

Reading 6964984927 measured this on `origin/main`. The trio never publishes into `txStore`, so both same-origin gates stepped aside. plugin-audit's `api.sudo()` insert carried the body's primary handle to the telemetry driver, and the statement ran on the primary connection, which has no `sys_audit_log`. On a Postgres primary, the refused statement turned COMMIT into a rollback.

## Tests

Pins (seat ruling) and their ablations, each run through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. Every ablation landed (anchor 1 to 0, blob changed) and was restored (blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty). The dist legs were proved with `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` (`--absent` on mutate, present after the restore rebuild).

| Pin | Where | Ablation | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 engine: trio ledger rows land on telemetry with no foreign handle; carve-out noted once; rollback keeps the orphan row | `engine-transaction-same-origin.test.ts`, new describe "a handle the ScopedContext trio opened is attributed to its owner (#35028)" | A: drop the `recordTrioTransactionScope` call | 5 red of 28 |
| 1 runtime: action-body write in tx with plugin-audit on a split engine keeps sys_audit_log + sys_activity | `packages/qa/dogfood/test/action-body-transaction-audit-split.dogfood.test.ts` (bootStack + real AuditPlugin + `telemetry` DriverPlugin, real `/actions` door) | A on dist (objectql rebuilt) | 3 of 3 red |
| 1 runtime (knex better-sqlite3, os dev primary) | `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/action-body-transaction-rollup-child.integration.test.ts`, split case | A on dist | split case red |
| 2 single datasource: trio rides one handle, audit rolls back with it | new nested describe in the same objectql file; existing :558 case kept, comment reworded (title unchanged) | C: record a foreign owner | the single-datasource trio case red (plus 4 split cases) |
| forget on commit / rollback | objectql file | B1 / B2: drop the forget in commit / rollback | 1 red each |
| 3 cross-datasource business write refused, named | objectql file (insert, update, delete) + dogfood (`400 ERR_CROSS_DATASOURCE_TRANSACTION_WRITE`, message names the object) | A | red |
| 4 #34998 stall regression: body tx inserting a roll-up master-detail child completes inside the wall clock on SQLite | runtime file, single + split, bound 10 s | D: `transactionCoversDriverFor` returns false (business writes leave the handle and wait on SQLite's one connection) | both red at 30 s, with the #34998 signature: "exceeded wall-clock ceiling of 30000ms while awaiting host calls (after 3597 pump iterations)" |
| S1 detached `async` `afterFind` run: its cross-datasource business write under an open trio handle lands, with no handle | objectql file, "lets an async afterFind run, detached from the open trio handle, write a business object on another datasource" | E: replace `!this.isClosedUnitHandle(explicitTransaction)` with `true` | 1 red of 29: `CrossDatasourceTransactionWriteError` received instead of `stored` |
| 5 live pg: an off-origin ledger write neither aborts the business tx nor rolls back on commit | runtime file, `describe.skipIf(!OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL)`, pg primary + SQLite telemetry | A on dist | both red: 25P02 "current transaction is aborted" for two inserts; one insert answered 200 with 0 lines on disk (silent rollback) |

S1 was measured before it was fixed: the new pin, run on `1ea3deab98` with no code change, failed 1 of 29 with `FAILED CrossDatasourceTransactionWriteError: insert of 'ledger' inside transaction() resolves to datasource 'ledger_db', but the transaction is open on 'primary'`. With the guard (`fe13609b7b`) the file passes 29 of 29. Ablation E ran through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `9ed8195b6c32` to `c224861e208a`), went red as above, and was restored (blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty). A first attempt with a replacement that was a substring of the anchor was refused by the tool before any test ran. The objectql tests import the source, so no dist leg applies.

Fix-round suites on head `91960c4f5a`:
- objectql `test`: 610 files / 13733 tests passed (`VERDICT command-exit 0`).
- objectql `typecheck`: exit 0.

Package suites on head `1ea3deab98` (previous round), all run in one locked chain:

- objectql `typecheck`: exit 0.
- runtime `typecheck`: exit 0.
- Runtime pins plus the two neighbouring transaction suites, with live pg: 3 files / 16 tests passed (exit 0).

## Live probe (re-run of the reader's probe, `os dev --fresh` on a probe app)

"Before" is origin/main's objectql source (`1282a464e9`) rebuilt. "After" is this branch.

| Layout | tx-1 / tx-2 audit | sys_audit_log rows | sys_activity rows | `Audit write FAILED` lines |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| before, split (default) | NO AUDIT ROW / NO AUDIT ROW | 5 | 2 | 1 |
| after, split | create / create (+ rollback orphan row) | 8 | 4 | 0 |
| before, `OS_TELEMETRY_DB=0` | create / create | 7 | 4 | 0 |
| after, `OS_TELEMETRY_DB=0` | create / create (rollback leaves none) | 7 | 4 | 0 |

## Acceptance notes

- After the fix, the split layout keeps the rolled-back body transaction's audit row as an orphan row. This is the 2026-08-06 carve-out ruling applied to the trio; the single-datasource layout still rolls it back.
- Four mechanical call-site edits are outside the claim's file surface (listed under What changes).
- The test surface of the query-options erasure ratchet stays at 236: the new runtime file types its read options instead of using `as any`.
